sentences.5.1 Liker du været i Norge?: 5.1 Do you like the weather in Norway?
sentences.Nordmenn snakker mye om været og ser oft: Norwegians talk a lot about the weather and often check yr.no.
sentences.Vi spør fem på gata:: We ask five people on the street:
sentences.Liker du været og årstidene i Norge?: Do you like the weather and the seasons in Norway?
In winter I can play outside in the snow.
I usually go skiing and make a snowman.
sentences.Om vinteren er det glatt på veien, og de: In winter the roads are slippery, and it's hard to walk.
It's cold from September to May.
In winter I go to Spain.
I live in Spain from October to March.
sentences.Om sommeren reiser jeg hjem til Norge og: In summer I go home to Norway and spend time with my children and grandchildren.
sentences.Det pleier å være fint vær i Norge om so: The weather is usually nice in Norway in summer.
I like the weather in Norway in summer.
sentences.Det er ikke så varmt, og det er frisk lu: It's not too hot, and the air is fresh.
In my home country it's very hot.
People in Norway enjoy themselves in summer.
sentences.Jeg liker alle årstidene i Norge, for de: I like all the seasons in Norway, because change is nice.
sentences.Jeg elsker å trene ute. Om våren, sommer: I love training outdoors. In spring, summer and autumn I usually run and cycle, and in winter I usually go skiing.
Norwegians are born with skis on their feet.
About 33,000 Norwegians live in the USA.
sentences.Om vinteren bor det ca. 60 000 nordmenn: In winter about 60,000 Norwegians live in Spain.
